name: Wault Finance WUSDMaster unbounded spot WEX swap and pro-rata redeem
summary: WUSDMaster.stake() swapped a share of each USDT deposit into WEX at the pair's spot price with zero minimum output and minted WUSD 1:1, while redeem() paid a pro-rata slice of the contract's WEX. The attacker redeemed flash-borrowed WUSD for WEX, pumped the pair, staked 68 times so the contract bought WEX at inflated prices, then sold the WEX back.
notes: The reset is WUSD's setMinter to WUSDMaster, the mint grant stake() and redeem() need; the master itself was deployed 465 blocks earlier and never changed. Its later permille and ownership changes only scale the swap or move a role.

Loss is the net USDT outflow of the victims taken together: the WEX/USDT pair, WUSDMaster and its treasury. The 94.17M WEX that left WUSDMaster ended back in the pair, so WEX nets to zero and needs no price. It is close to the attacker's 370.19 ETH of realised proceeds.
